messages:
jordan: Heads-up: Trellis is evaluating a migration away from CompetitorX. Main asks: prompt/response parity, predictable token billing, SCIM/SSO, and enterprise audit logs. They're nervous about subtle response deltas. Can we run a compatibility POC next week?

maya: I can lead presales. Need to confirm whether they require Private (VPC) or hosted with strict residency. Also they sent a security questionnaire (pdf) with 40+ items. @nina can you take point on that?

leo: Ill own the smoke infra + test harness. Plan: side-by-side replay of 1k representative prompts + metric thresholds (BLEU-like + exact-match on structured fields). Will produce a delta report showing where outputs diverge.

nina: I can start the SQ. Immediate flags: Q7 (encryption at rest), Q15 (third-party subprocesses), Q23 (retention of prompts). Need template answers and any legal-approved wording for hosted vs private.

jordan: Pricing note from Trellis: they want migration credits and a one-month pilot discount. They asked if we can estimate incremental token cost due to tokenization differences vs CompetitorX.

leo: Quick note on tokenization: small prompts can inflate token counts by ~3-8% depending on tokenizer. I'll run a tokenizer diff on a 10k prompt sample and share exact %s. That will inform the billing delta.

maya: For acceptance criteria, they require <=5% functional regression on critical prompt set and no more than 10% token billing variance for chat endpoints. Is that feasible?

leo: Feasible to try. Two engineering caveats: our streaming stop-token behavior differs slightly from CompetitorX (we emit EOT token differently). To avoid false-positives in parity checks, add client-side finalization: `if (resp.endsWith(\"\\u0003\")) resp = resp.slice(0,-1)`. I'll add this snippet to the runbook.

security-bot: deploy checklist: ensure KMS integration documented. For hosted POC, standard: "Redwood does not retain customer prompt/response data by default; customers may opt-in for retention for evals with explicit consent." Include link to DPA page.

nina: Thanks. I'll use that wording and run the SQ answers by legal. Also asked if SCIM provisioning is supported - yes, we support SCIM and SAML SSO, but SCIM bulk user sync is in beta. Flagging as an enterprise blocker if they need full SCIM today.

jordan: Trellis requires SCIM full sync + audit logs. If SCIM beta isn't acceptable, they may require Private. @maya please confirm tradeoff with customer.

maya: Will confirm. Also they want per-route latency SLOs for the pilot (p95 < 250ms for text-gen). Any risks?

leo: p95 < 250ms is realistic on Dedicated pools for the model family they use (`open-chat-large`). On hosted we'll need to validate under 300 qps. I'll provision a dedicated staging pod for the smoke run to meet targets.

deploy-bot: Staging cluster `trellis-smoke-3172004567` created. IPs: `13.52.101.9/32`, `13.52.101.10/32`. API keys minted and stored in vault (auto-expire 72h).

jordan: Great. Timeline: prep this week (security answers + tokenization report), smoke-run Wed 09:00 PT, follow-up with Trellis on Thurs. Owners: maya (customer comms/contract), leo (tests/infrastructure), nina (security SQ), jordan (overall).

maya: Pricing follow-up: can we offer $10k in migration credits + 30% pilot discount for 30 days? Finance wants usage estimates first. leo, can you provide token delta + expected token consumption for 30 days at their projected volume?

leo: Will produce a tokenization delta spreadsheet and a 30-day usage estimate by EOD tomorrow. Plan: sample 10k prompts -> token counts vs CompetitorX -> extrapolate.

nina: Legal/security note: if they require Private for SCIM/audit reasons, prep an estimate for onboarding time (3-4 weeks) and any additional cost.

jordan: Thanks team. I'll draft the email to Trellis with the proposed pilot terms, the smoke-run invite, and the checklist (SCIM caveat + streaming finalization snippet).

maya: One more: Trellis asked about customer-facing error behavior differences (e.g., truncated completions). Can we include a short doc about mitigation patterns (client retries, final-token cleanup, fallback to smaller model)?

leo: Yup. I'll attach `runbook/compatibility-mitigation.md` in the invite with examples and a recommended client patch.

security-bot: Reminder: include SOC2 + DPA links in the packet.

jordan: Ok closing notes: smoke-run Wed 3172060000 (09:00 PT). Please update the shared doc and I'll send invites.
